name: God Is Able International Prayer Ministries
tagline: We believe. We pray. We serve.
description: God Is Able International Prayer Ministries — a global family of prayer warriors in Germany, Nigeria, Cameroon, the USA, Canada, the UK and beyond. Join our prayer lines, send a prayer request, and support our missions in Cameroon.
verse: Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.
